subject.title: [Feature Request] Make command options clickable buttons in Feishu (e.g., /reasoning)

question: Should no-argument command-status replies with selectable options, such as `/reasoning` and `/verbose`, emit shared typed command-action presentation for capable channels, or should Feishu implement a channel-specific card transform?
rationale: The clean boundary spans shared command-status replies and channel renderers; repository policy favors typed portable presentation actions over channel-specific parsing of `Options:` text, but that behavior needs maintainer product direction before automation changes it.

options.title: Shared typed presentation
options.body: Emit typed command-action buttons from the shared command-status reply path so Feishu and other capable channels can render native controls while text-only channels keep fallback text.

options.title: Feishu-only card transform
options.body: Teach Feishu to transform recognized command-status option text into cards, accepting a channel-specific parser and extra maintenance risk.

options.title: Native args-menu only
options.body: Leave no-argument status replies text-only and rely only on channel-native args-menu surfaces where they already exist.

recommendation.title: Shared typed presentation
recommendation.body: Emit typed command-action buttons from the shared command-status reply path so Feishu and other capable channels can render native controls while text-only channels keep fallback text.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the typed presentation command-action contract that is the likely shared implementation boundary for this choice.
